title: GitHub links in footer and change log
summary: Guests and signed-in users can open the MyAPES Core GitHub repository, start a new issue, or browse discussions from the shared footer and Change Log Hub.
changes: Add GitHub, Open an issue, and Discussions links to the shared site footer on every layout screen.
Add a public Feedback & source section on the Change Log Hub with the same GitHub links.
Centralize repository, issue chooser, and discussions URLs in config/myapes.php for reuse and optional env overrides.
version_rationale: Patch release: backward-compatible public navigation to GitHub feedback channels; no API or auth behaviour change.
validation: php artisan test --filter=ChangeLogPageTest covering public GitHub links on the footer and change log while staff-only release references stay hidden from guests.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after filling release notes.
known_limitations: Links open GitHub in a new browser tab; users need a GitHub account to file issues or post in discussions.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. To remove the links, revert the footer nav, Change Log Hub community block, config entries, and related styles from this release.
provenance: Defined by GitHub links in footer and Change Log Hub for MyAPES Account issue #179.
